description: Request cancellation on the same connection. `thread/search/cancel` targets only `thread/search`; `thread/search/stream/cancel` targets only `thread/search/stream`. Cancellation is idempotent: the cancel response acknowledges the request, and an interrupted search completes with an error after its subprocess is stopped and reaped. If completion races cancellation, the original search may still succeed. An already-completed search is unaffected.
title: ThreadSearchCancelParams
